root_cause.summary: A second process holds a BEGIN IMMEDIATE SQLite write transaction long enough for application writes to exceed the configured busy timeout.

expected_discriminators: reads continue to succeed while writes fail
failures disappear after the competing writer releases the transaction
expected_evidence: application log event sqlite_operational_error contains database is locked
POST /orders returns 503 during the lock window
GET /products remains 200 during the same window
causal_notes: The lock-holder process is the competing writer, not merely a nearby change.
The short SQLite busy timeout converts contention into visible request failures.
